transcript.speaker: Ben Holloway
transcript.text: I wanted to check in specifically about on-call load - I noticed Ravi's been paged a lot the last few weeks.

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: Yeah, he's mentioned it's wearing on him. Between the database incident, a couple of noisy alerts that turn out to be false positives, and just being one of only three people in the rotation, he's had a rough stretch.

transcript.speaker: Ben Holloway
transcript.text: How many false-positive pages would you estimate in the last month?

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: At least six that I know of, mostly from a disk-usage alert that's poorly tuned - it fires at 80% but our disks regularly sit at 82-85% under normal operation with no actual problem.

transcript.speaker: Ben Holloway
transcript.text: That sounds like an easy fix - can we just retune the threshold?

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: Yes, I'll raise it to 92% and add a slower-burn secondary alert instead of one noisy threshold. I should have that done this week.

transcript.speaker: Ben Holloway
transcript.text: Good. Beyond alert tuning, do we need a fourth person in the on-call rotation?

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: I think so, longer term. Liam's expressed some interest in joining the rotation, but he'd need ramp-up time and a proper handoff of runbooks first.

transcript.speaker: Ben Holloway
transcript.text: Let's start that ramp-up now rather than waiting. Can you put together a plan for getting Liam onboarded to on-call?

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: Yes, I'll draft an onboarding plan and timeline by next week.

transcript.speaker: Ben Holloway
transcript.text: In the meantime, should we lighten Ravi's load specifically, even before Liam's ready?

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: I could swap some of his upcoming shifts with mine for the next couple weeks while we fix the alert noise.

transcript.speaker: Ben Holloway
transcript.text: Let's do that. Also - is this something we should talk to Ravi about directly, or would that feel like we're making a bigger deal of it than he wants?

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: I think a direct, low-key conversation would help, so it doesn't seem like we're ignoring it. I'll talk to him this week.

transcript.speaker: Ben Holloway
transcript.text: Thanks Amara, appreciate you flagging this before it became a bigger problem.

summary_key_points: On-call burnout is a growing concern, driven partly by a poorly tuned disk-usage alert causing frequent false positives
The disk-usage alert threshold will be raised and a secondary alert added to reduce noise
Liam will begin ramping up to join the on-call rotation as a fourth person
Amara will temporarily take some of Ravi's shifts while the alert noise is fixed
